question: In which year did Gongsa Ugyen Wangchuck become the first monarch of Bhutan?
solution:
The correct answer is **__1907.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In 1907 Gongsa Ugyen Wangchuck become the first monarch of Bhutan.**
 
• **The Constitution of Bhutan was enacted on 18 July 2008 by the Royal Government of Bhutan.**
 
• **Bhutan's political system has changed from an absolute monarchy to a constitutional monarchy.**
 
• Bhutan is the Sovereign Kingdom and the Sovereign power belongs to the people of Bhutan.
 
• This Constitution is the Supreme Law of the State.
 
• **Princess Ashi Sonam Dechen Wangchuck is a princess of Bhutan.**
 
 
• She is the daughter of the** fourth King of Bhutan Jigme Singye Wangchuck and his wife, Queen Mother Ashi Dorji Wangmo Wangchuck**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The current King of Bhutan is Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck**.
 
• On Dec 9, 2006, Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck became the king and is known as the**" Dragon King”** of Bhutan.
